title: ACIS retained-output slot census continuation
mode: Local static source audit; no code or test changes
scope: Continue the planned census of allocations in limit-aware SAB parsing, graph construction, and ACIS projection
Check the public nodesOfType helper and signature-search scratch allocation for scope and bounds
Record whether another generated accounting control is justified

method.kind: Read-only source and in-tree callsite review
method.limitations: Static accounting audit only. It does not measure allocator capacity, peak resident memory, client-created DRW_AcisModel construction, or downstream client usage.

evidence.parsedRecords: Record starts are limited by maxRecords and consumeRecord; initial reserve is bounded by the remaining-byte lower bound and maxRecords.
evidence.parsedTokensAndNames: Token vector capacity and type-part capacity use explicit ceilings; tag work and per-string/cumulative string bytes have separate limits.
evidence.graphBuild: Node slots, reference-count planner slots, copied token slots, and resolved pointer slots are charged to graphItems; graph scans/copies and strings have separate accounting.
evidence.projection: Projected rows, sets, cache nodes, pending worklist entries, reachability rows, diagnostics, and cycle guards are charged to outputItems before insertion; transform-token copies use token-capacity accounting.
evidence.signatureSearch: KMP prefix vector length is determined by one of two fixed short signatures; scan work is linear in input length.
evidence.nodesOfType: nodesOfType allocates one returned int per matching node. In-tree source search found no production callsites; tests call it on locally constructed/bounded models. The public helper has no limits parameter and operates on caller-owned DRW_AcisModel, so it is recorded outside the limit-aware parse/projection contract rather than as a parser-path bypass.

assessment.planImpact: Closes the queued local ACIS retained-output/scratch-slot census. Resume the next locally actionable plan item and do not wait for external-only evidence.

workingTree: The worktree was extensively modified before this audit. The plan additions and receipt remain unstaged and uncommitted; unrelated changes were preserved.
